title: 一键提取当前页面外链的小脚本---萌新小白入门教程 5-常用插件
author: 睡觉想飞 🥒
content:
之前看 哥飞深圳年终的演示发现有这样的小脚本 ,就用 cc 也搞了一个 如果有 bug 就自己用 ai 修下,
Bookmarklet书签脚本
效果如下:

javascript:(function(){var highlightStyle='outline: 3px solid #ff0000 !important; background: rgba(255, 255, 0, 0.3) !important; color: #000 !important; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(255,0,0,0.5) !important; transition: all 0.3s;';var currentHost=window.location.hostname.replace(/^www\./,'');var links=document.querySelectorAll('a[href]');var external=[];var seen=new Set();function escapeCSV(str){if(!str)return'';str=str.replace(/"/g,'""');if(str.search(/("|,|\n|\r)/g)>=0){str='"'+str+'"';}return str;}function isVisible(elem){return!!(elem.offsetWidth||elem.offsetHeight||elem.getClientRects().length);}var csvRows=["URL,锚文本/Alt,Rel属性,打开方式,可见性"];for(var i=0;i<links.length;i++){var a=links[i];try{var url=new URL(a.href,window.location.origin);if(!['http:','https:'].includes(url.protocol))continue;var linkHost=url.hostname.replace(/^www\./,'');if(linkHost!==currentHost){a.style.cssText+=highlightStyle;var anchorText=a.innerText.trim().replace(/[\r\n]+/g,' ');if(!anchorText&&a.querySelector('img')){anchorText='[图片] '+(a.querySelector('img').alt||'无Alt属性');}anchorText=anchorText||'[无文字]';var rel=a.getAttribute('rel')||'dofollow';if(rel==='')rel='dofollow';var target=a.getAttribute('target')||'_self';var visibility=isVisible(a)?'可见':'隐藏/不可见';if(!seen.has(url.href)){seen.add(url.href);external.push({url:url.href,text:anchorText,rel:rel,target:target,visible:visibility});csvRows.push([escapeCSV(url.href),escapeCSV(anchorText),escapeCSV(rel),escapeCSV(target),escapeCSV(visibility)].join(','));}}}catch(e){}}var csvString="\uFEFF"+csvRows.join("\n");var blob=new Blob([csvString],{type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8;'});var urlObj=URL.createObjectURL(blob);var filename='External_Links_'+currentHost+'.csv';var w=window.open('','_blank','width=900,height=650');if(!w){alert('请允许弹出窗口以查看结果！');return;}var html='<html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>SEO 审计: '+currentHost+'</title><style>body{margin:0;padding:20px;font-family:sans-serif;background:#f5f5f5;color:#333}.header{background:#fff;padding:20px;margin-bottom:20px;border-radius:8px}.btn{padding:10px 20px;background:#27ae60;color:white;text-decoration:none;border-radius:4px;font-weight:bold;display:inline-block}.btn:hover{background:#219150}table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;background:#fff}th,td{padding:10px;border-bottom:1px solid #eee;text-align:left}th{background:#f8f9fa}.tag{padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;color:#fff;font-size:11px}.tag-follow{background:#27ae60}.tag-nofollow{background:#e74c3c}</style></head><body><div class="header"><h2>🔎 外部链接报告: '+external.length+' 个</h2><p>页面已高亮显示外链。 <a href="'+urlObj+'" download="'+filename+'" class="btn">📥 下载 Excel (CSV)</a></p></div><table><thead><tr><th>URL</th><th>锚文本</th><th>Rel</th><th>Target</th><th>可见性</th></tr></thead><tbody>'+external.map(item=>{let rc=item.rel.includes('nofollow')?'tag-nofollow':'tag-follow';return '<tr><td><a href="'+item.url+'" target="_blank">'+item.url+'</a></td><td>'+item.text.replace(/</g,'<')+'</td><td><span class="tag '+rc+'">'+item.rel+'</span></td><td>'+item.target+'</td><td>'+item.visible+'</td></tr>';}).join('')+'</tbody></table></body></html>';w.document.write(html);w.document.close();})();
